name: USAJOBS
tagline: Official U.S. federal government job listings API for searching public sector openings.
description: USAJOBS provides a free REST API for searching and retrieving U.S. federal job opportunity announcements. Developers register for an API key and call data.usajobs.gov endpoints with Host, User-Agent, and Authorization-Key headers. Responses are JSON and cover job titles, locations, agencies, pay, and application details for building job boards, alerts, and career tools.

auth.details: API key via Authorization-Key header plus User-Agent (email) and Host headers; self-serve registration on developer.usajobs.gov.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Official pricing/free-tier terms are not published. API-token registration is required. Published access limits: Search Jobs—10,000 rows per query and 500 per page; Code List and Dynamic Search—no limits.

rate_limits: Search Jobs: maximum 10,000 rows per query and 500 rows per page. Code List API and Dynamic Search: no limits. No requests-per-second or requests-per-day quota is published.
use_cases: search federal job openings by keyword and location
list recent vacancies for a specific agency or series
fetch job opportunity announcement details for a position
build alerts when new federal roles match a skill set
aggregate public-sector openings for a career board
